blocks.text: Haiti has been engulfed in crisis since 2018, with protests, a presidential assassination and widespread gang violence bringing the country to its knees. But earlier this week, Haiti’s Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime hailed a major win in the battle against the violence, thanks to “the commitment of the Salvadorean forces in the fight against gangs.”
